final: WITH dc AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), ra AS (SELECT region, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM dc GROUP BY region), ab AS (SELECT dc.district_id, dc.region, dc.cnt, dc.cnt - ra.avg_cnt AS excess FROM dc JOIN ra ON ra.region = dc.region WHERE dc.cnt > ra.avg_cnt) SELECT district_id, region, cnt AS account_count, excess AS excess_over_region_avg, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM ab) AS ratio_to_avg_above FROM ab ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_above DESC LIMIT 10
